draft_follow_up.subject: Northstar pilot: security documents and retention question
draft_follow_up.body:
Hi Carla,

Thanks for today's conversation. As agreed, I am sending our security questionnaire and data-retention policy for your legal team. I will also confirm the available ninety-day transcript deletion options before you begin the review.

We have noted your preferred pilot start date of 12 October and the initial scope of five SDRs. Once legal is comfortable, we can confirm the remaining order and onboarding steps.

Best,
Maya
